notes.title: Tanuki Sunset Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]v1.0.1[/h2]

Hey there!

Thank you very much for playing Tanuki Sunset. We hope all of you are having a rad time drifting down legendary trails ~
Launch weekend was very exciting for us. We short-listed critical bugs that were impacting the experience of our players. These are the major changes that were addressed in this version of the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed Tutorial level sometimes not loading properly after resetting Save Data.
[*] Fixed unintended behaviour when using controller and keyboard input at the same time.
[*] Fixed 'Near Miss' tricks triggering from the Phone pick-up.
[*] Fixed score on Arcade Trials not properly saving after holding a previous record.
[*] Fixed BGM not moving on to the next song.
[*] Fixed radio BGM overlapping with some cutscenes.
[*] Added confirmation panel prompt before leaving a level in progress.
[*] Added missing 'Stickers' information panel from Map.
[*] Added option to hide speedometer and map HUD to Bob's radio.
[*] Adjusted song list to prevent much repetition of specific songs.
[*] Adjusted car horn variety and volume.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and understanding! Keep enjoying Tanuki Sunset!
We can’t wait to hear your stories and feedback - find us on our Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/RewindGamesCA]@rewindgamesca[/url] or through our email: hello@rewindgames.ca

Jose M
Rewind Games
